entries.name: SLSA Provenance
entries.supported_claim: Build process and materials in an attestation predicate.
entries.best_use: Bind reviewed source and build inputs to an artifact.

entries.name: in-toto
entries.supported_claim: Signed metadata describing steps, materials, and products.
entries.best_use: Record review/generation steps in a larger layout.
entries.important_boundary: Truth of unverified claims inside metadata.

entries.name: Sigstore Cosign
entries.supported_claim: Signing and verification for containers, blobs, and attestations.
entries.best_use: Distribute and verify a provenance statement.
entries.important_boundary: The semantic quality of the predicate.

entries.name: SPDX
entries.best_use: Record packages/files and license conclusions around a change.
entries.important_boundary: How code was generated unless an extension/profile states it.

entries.name: CycloneDX
entries.best_use: Track dependencies introduced by an assisted patch.

entries.name: DSSE
entries.supported_claim: A signature envelope designed for arbitrary typed payloads.
entries.best_use: Protect a custom AI-assistance statement while retaining its type.
entries.important_boundary: That the payload schema is meaningful or sufficient.

entries.name: C2PA
entries.supported_claim: Signed manifests and assertions for digital content.
entries.best_use: Relevant when code projects also publish AI-assisted media/assets.

entries.name: OpenSSF Scorecard
entries.supported_claim: Automated checks of repository security practices.
entries.best_use: Add repository posture context to dependency provenance review.
entries.important_boundary: Provenance of a particular code block.

field_provenance.supported_claim: source-backed at the cited URL, subject to the recorded review date/version
field_provenance.important_boundary: author analysis unless the linked source explicitly states it
